sed_ensure_journal_entry = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   has_variable = sed_enabled
   NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_sed_diagnostics }
   NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_sed_diagnostics }
  }
  add_journal_entry = { type = je_sed_diagnostics }
 }
}

sed_monthly_update = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_ensure_journal_entry = yes
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_monthly_refresh }
   sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } sed_refresh_national_plan = yes sed_coord_sync = yes }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_monthly_refresh } } sed_asc_refresh = yes }
  sed_schedule_auto_event = yes
  # Advisory only: never opens a trade route, because the script cannot do it.
  sed_check_import_notices = yes
 }
}

sed_refresh_diagnostics = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_ensure_mode_default = yes
  sed_follow_projects = yes
  sed_outcome_review = yes
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_balance value = net_total_income }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_operating_balance value = net_fixed_income }
 # fixed_income menos net_fixed_income; vanilla/common/script_values/ip4_je_values.txt e tabela de triggers Tiger 1.19.0
 set_variable = { name = sed_fixed_expenses value = sed_fixed_expenses_value }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/war_support_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_gold value = gold_reserves }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_debt value = principal }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_credit value = credit }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/ip5_je_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_gdp value = gdp }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/ip5_je_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_population value = total_population }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_sol value = average_sol }
 # vanilla/common/journal_entries/00_sick_man.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_literacy value = literacy_rate }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction value = modifier:country_construction_add }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_public_projects value = num_queued_government_constructions }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_private_projects value = num_queued_private_constructions }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/01_power_bloc_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_military_expenses value = military_expenses }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/01_power_bloc_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_military_share value = military_expenses_share }
  set_variable = { name = sed_last_year value = year }
  # The game's month trigger is zero-based (vanilla ip4_custom_loc.txt).
  set_variable = { name = sed_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_month_key value = { value = year multiply = 12 add = month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_in_default value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_in_default value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_gdp_per_capita value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_per_capita_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_population > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gdp_per_capita value = { value = var:sed_gdp divide = var:sed_population } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_per_capita_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_credit > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share value = { value = var:sed_debt divide = var:sed_credit } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_balance < 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks value = { value = var:sed_gold min = 0 divide = { value = var:sed_balance multiply = -1 } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_infrastructure_short_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_low_access_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_shortage_buildings value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_understaffed_buildings value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_hiring_failure_buildings value = 0 }
  every_scope_state = {
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_states add = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_infrastructure_short_states add = 1 } } }
   if = { limit = { market_access < 1 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_low_access_states add = 1 } } }
   every_scope_building = {
    limit = { level > 0 }
    if = { limit = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_shortage_buildings add = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { occupancy < 1 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_understaffed_buildings add = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { has_failed_hires = yes } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_hiring_failure_buildings add = 1 } } }
   }
  }
  sed_update_growth = yes
  sed_refresh_railway_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_construction_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_supply_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
  sed_refresh_public_upkeep = yes
  sed_asc_refresh = yes
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } sed_coord_sync = yes }
 }
}

sed_refresh_railway_candidates = {
 clear_variable_list = sed_railway_candidates
 # Counts use one primary reason per state so the breakdown adds up to the
 # deficit total instead of counting the same state under several filters.
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_deficit_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_no_railway_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_not_ready_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_blocked_states value = 0 }
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = {
    has_variable = sed_railway_request_pending
    NOT = {
     OR = {
      AND = { has_building = building_railway
       b:building_railway = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } }
      # A founded railway has no building yet; the queue itself proves it is
      # still in progress. Without this, the request was cleared as abandoned
      # on the next reading and could be founded again elsewhere.
      AND = { NOT = { has_building = building_railway }
       var:sed_railway_intent_level = 0
       owner = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 } }
     }
    }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_intent_level
     has_building = building_railway
     b:building_railway.level > var:sed_railway_intent_level
    }
    sed_railway_record_completed = yes
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_intent_level }
    sed_railway_record_abandoned = yes
   }
   remove_variable = sed_railway_request_pending
   remove_variable = sed_railway_intent_level
  }
  if = {
   limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_deficit_states add = 1 } }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_railway } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_no_railway_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     b:building_railway = {
      OR = {
       level <= 0
       occupancy < 0.8
       has_failed_hires = yes
       building_has_goods_shortage = yes
       level_after_queued_constructions > level
      }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_not_ready_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     OR = {
      NOT = { is_incorporated = yes }
      NOT = { can_construct_building = building_railway }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_blocked_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = infrastructure_delta multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = {
    add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_railway_candidates target = prev }
   }
  }
 }
}

sed_run_railway_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_railway_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  # A founding reads level 0; a later reading infers completion from the queue.
  if = { limit = { has_building = building_railway }
   set_variable = { name = sed_railway_intent_level value = b:building_railway.level }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_intent_level value = 0 } }
  start_building_construction = building_railway
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_railway_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = { remove_variable = sed_railway_intent_level }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

}

sed_refresh_construction_candidates = {
 clear_variable_list = sed_construction_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_wood_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_iron_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_coal_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_grain_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_fabric_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_tools_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_groceries_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_clothes_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_small_arms_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_artillery_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_ammunition_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_paper_candidates
 # Same primary-reason cascade as the railway counts. Only states that already
 # have a construction sector enter this denominator.
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_sector_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_not_ready_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_blocked_states value = 0 }
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = {
    has_variable = sed_construction_request_pending
    OR = {
     NOT = { has_building = building_construction_sector }
     b:building_construction_sector = { level_after_queued_constructions <= level }
    }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_intent_level
     has_building = building_construction_sector
     b:building_construction_sector.level > var:sed_construction_intent_level
    }
    sed_construction_record_completed = yes
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_intent_level }
    sed_construction_record_abandoned = yes
   }
   remove_variable = sed_construction_request_pending
   remove_variable = sed_construction_intent_level
  }
  if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_construction_sector }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_sector_states add = 1 } }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     b:building_construction_sector = {
      OR = {
       level <= 0
       occupancy < 0.9
       has_failed_hires = yes
       building_has_goods_shortage = yes
       level_after_queued_constructions > level
      }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_not_ready_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     OR = {
      NOT = { is_incorporated = yes }
      NOT = { can_construct_building = building_construction_sector }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_blocked_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = {
   is_player = yes
   has_variable = sed_enabled
   num_queued_government_constructions >= 3
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_construction_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population }
   max = 1
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = {
    add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_construction_candidates target = prev }
   }
  }
 }
}

sed_run_construction_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_construction_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_construction_intent_level value = b:building_construction_sector.level }
  start_building_construction = building_construction_sector
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 2 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_construction_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = { remove_variable = sed_construction_intent_level }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

}

# Country counters; completion is inferred from the queue leaving and level rising.
sed_railway_record_completed = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_completed }
   change_variable = { name = sed_railway_completed add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_completed value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_result value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_railway_intent_level
}

   change_variable = { name = sed_railway_abandoned add = 1 }

  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }

}

# Keep the first sample of each recorded month as the anchor. A second click in
# the same month cannot erase the baseline or pretend that a whole month passed.
sed_update_growth = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_anchor_month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_month value = var:sed_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_gdp value = var:sed_gdp }
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { var:sed_month_key > var:sed_anchor_month }
  set_variable = { name = sed_previous_month value = var:sed_anchor_month }
  set_variable = { name = sed_previous_gdp value = var:sed_anchor_gdp }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_month value = var:sed_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_gdp value = var:sed_gdp }
 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth_available value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth_months value = 0 }
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_previous_gdp var:sed_previous_gdp > 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth value = { value = var:sed_gdp divide = var:sed_previous_gdp subtract = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth_months value = { value = var:sed_month_key subtract = var:sed_previous_month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth_available value = 1 }
 }
}
sed_ensure_mode_default = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual has_variable = sed_mode_assisted has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } } }
  sed_set_mode_assisted = yes
 }
}

# Country scope; the persistent marker is written before an automatic attempt.
sed_record_auto_attempt = {
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_last_attempt_month value = { value = year multiply = 12 add = month } }
 }
}

   else_if = {

   else_if = {

    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {

   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   sed_wood_supply_demand = yes
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = sed_site_readiness
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_wood_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }

sed_run_wood_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } sed_refresh_investment_prices = yes sed_refresh_input_readings = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_wood_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels } }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  if = {
   limit = { sed_wood_logging_camp_investment_eligible = yes }
   # A founding reads level 0; the monthly review then infers completion from the queue.
   set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_level value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_logging_camp }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_level value = b:building_logging_camp.level }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_variant value = 1 }
   start_building_construction = building_logging_camp
  }
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 3 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = {
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_request_pending value = yes }
     if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } var:sed_wood_intent_level = 0 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_wood_found_pm_pending value = var:sed_wood_intent_variant }
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

}

  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }

 remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level
 remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant
}

 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } sed_refresh_investment_prices = yes sed_refresh_input_readings = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_coal_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels } }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  if = {
   limit = { sed_coal_coal_mine_investment_eligible = yes }
   # A founding reads level 0; the monthly review then infers completion from the queue.
   set_variable = { name = sed_coal_intent_level value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_coal_mine }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coal_intent_level value = b:building_coal_mine.level }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coal_intent_variant value = 1 }
   start_building_construction = building_coal_mine
  }
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coal_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 5 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coal_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_coal_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_coal_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = {
     set_variable = { name = sed_coal_request_pending value = yes }
     if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } var:sed_coal_intent_level = 0 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_coal_found_pm_pending value = var:sed_coal_intent_variant }
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_coal_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_coal_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_coal_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

}

    set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_intent_level value = b:building_arms_industry.level }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_intent_variant value = 1 }
   start_building_construction = building_arms_industry
  }
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 11 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_small_arms_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = {
     set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_request_pending value = yes }
     if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } var:sed_small_arms_intent_level = 0 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_found_pm_pending value = var:sed_small_arms_intent_variant }
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_small_arms_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_small_arms_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

sed_schedule_auto_event = {

  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_auto_event_pending } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_event_pending value = yes }
  trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.1 days = 23 }
 }
}

  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_auto_event_pending }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_event_pending value = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_retry_month value = sed_live_month_key }
  trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.1 days = 7 }
 }

sed_auto_apply_monthly = {
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_asc_window_start } } sed_asc_refresh = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_queue_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
 sed_configure_founded_industries = yes
 sed_refresh_trade_center = yes
 sed_refresh_admin = yes
 sed_refresh_power = yes
 sed_follow_projects = yes
 sed_refresh_public_upkeep = yes
 sed_outcome_review = yes
 sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
 sed_recover_existing_industry = yes
 sed_modernize_existing_industry = yes
 if = { limit = { sed_pm_upgrade_month_limit_reached = yes has_variable = sed_pm_upgrade_status OR = { var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 1 var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 3 } }
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
 }
 sed_apply_fiscal_policy = yes
 sed_apply_wage_policy = yes
 sed_apply_military_wage_policy = yes
 sed_watch_review = yes
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 2 }
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  sed_coord_sync = yes
  if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 11 } sed_auto_run_direct = yes }
  else = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 18 }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 10 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 20 } }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 9 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 19 } }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 13 } }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 2 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_coord_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 17 } }
   }
  }
 }
 else = { sed_auto_run_direct = yes }
 if = { limit = { sed_pm_upgrade_month_limit_reached = yes has_variable = sed_pm_upgrade_status }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 24 }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 1 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 23 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 25 } }
 }
 sed_asc_record_actions = yes
 # Store the actual result after either direct execution or delegation.
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_status value = var:sed_auto_action_status }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_year value = year }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
 # Only transient construction blockers start weekly checks.
 if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_auto_review_status = 11 var:sed_auto_review_status = 12 } }
  sed_schedule_auto_retry = yes
 }
}

    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_clothes_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_small_arms_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_small_arms_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_small_arms_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_small_arms_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = sed_site_readiness }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_small_arms_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_artillery_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_artillery_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_artillery_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_artillery_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = sed_site_readiness }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_artillery_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_ammunition_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_ammunition_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_ammunition_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_ammunition_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = sed_site_readiness }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_ammunition_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_paper_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_paper_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_paper_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_paper_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = sed_site_readiness }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.

  else_if = {

    limit = { sed_construction_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_construction_rank = 1 }

   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_admin_candidate_eligible = yes }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_admin_approval = yes
   }

  else_if = {

    order_by = { value = state_population }

    sed_run_trade_center_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_core_wood_eligible = yes } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_core_wood_eligible = yes }
    order_by = sed_site_readiness
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no

    sed_run_core_construction_approval = yes
   }

 }
 else_if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 10 } }
 else_if = { limit = { sed_auto_month_limit_reached = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 16 } }
 else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_private_levels > 0 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 11 } }
 else_if = { limit = { is_construction_paused = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 12 } }
 else_if = { limit = { sed_competing_builder_configured = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 13 } }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_direct_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 17 } }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_direct_budget_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 22 } }
 else = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 14 } }
}

sed_run_university_approval = {
 owner = { sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes }
 if = {
  limit = {
   sed_university_candidate = yes
   owner = { sed_auto_executor_safe = yes sed_university_ready = yes }
  }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
   sed_record_auto_attempt = yes
  }
  start_building_construction = building_university
  owner = {
   if = { limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 18 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

sed_refresh_national_plan = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_refresh_investment_prices = yes
  sed_refresh_input_readings = yes
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_waiting value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_year value = year }
  set_variable = { name = sed_prev_year value = { value = year subtract = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_floor value = { value = sed_fixed_expenses_value min = 0 multiply = 4 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_required value = { value = var:sed_reserve_floor } }
  if = { limit = { net_total_income < 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_required value = { value = sed_fixed_expenses_value min = 0 multiply = 6 } }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_spare value = { value = gold_reserves subtract = var:sed_reserve_required min = 0 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_runway value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { net_total_income < 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_runway value = { value = var:sed_reserve_spare divide = { value = net_total_income multiply = -1 } } }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 1 }
  if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 4 } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = {
    AND = { net_total_income < 0 gold_reserves < { value = net_total_income multiply = -4 } }
    AND = { principal > 0 OR = { credit <= 0 principal > { value = credit multiply = 0.9 } } }
   } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes net_total_income < 0 } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 5 } }
  else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 2 } }
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_railway
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_construction
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_wood
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_iron
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_coal
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_grain
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_fabric
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_tools
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_groceries
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_clothes
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_small_arms
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_artillery
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_ammunition
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_paper
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_railway
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_construction
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_wood
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_iron
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_coal
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_grain
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_fabric
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_tools
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_groceries
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_clothes
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_small_arms
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_artillery
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_ammunition
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_paper
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_railway
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_construction
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_wood
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_iron
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_coal
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_grain
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_fabric
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_tools
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_groceries
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_clothes
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_small_arms
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_artillery
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_ammunition
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_paper
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_wood value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {

   market = { mg:wood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_logging_camp } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_wood value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_wood value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:wood ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_sample_month } }
   remove_variable = sed_wood_short_months
   remove_variable = sed_wood_meta_year
  }
  if = { limit = {  market = { mg:wood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_sample_month var:sed_wood_short_sample_month = sed_live_month_key } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_short_sample_gap value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_sample_month }
     set_variable = { name = sed_short_sample_gap value = { value = sed_live_month_key subtract = var:sed_wood_short_sample_month } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:sed_short_sample_gap = 1 has_variable = sed_wood_short_months }
     change_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months value = 1 } }
    remove_variable = sed_short_sample_gap
   }
   else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_months } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months value = 1 }
   }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_wood_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_meta_year value = year }
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_streak value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_meta_since value = year }
     # Price at the moment the goal begins, so its outcome can be measured later.
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_price_start value = {
      value = 0 market ?= { mg:wood ?= { value = market_goods_pricier multiply = 100 } } } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:sed_wood_meta_year < year }
     # Consecutive annual goals form a multi-year goal; a skipped year restarts it.
     if = { limit = { var:sed_wood_meta_year = var:sed_prev_year }
      change_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_streak add = 1 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_streak value = { value = var:sed_wood_goal_streak max = 5 } }
     }
     else = {
      set_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_streak value = 1 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_wood_meta_since value = year }
     }
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = {
   remove_variable = sed_wood_short_months
   # Shortage gone while a goal was active: record how long it lasted and how far
   # the market price moved from the goal's own starting point. This is a reading
   # for the player, not an economic effect; a new goal overwrites it.
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_meta_year }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_result_year value = year }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_result_years value = {
     value = year subtract = var:sed_wood_meta_since min = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_goal_result_price value = {
     value = 0 market ?= { mg:wood ?= { value = market_goods_pricier multiply = 100 } }
     if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_goal_price_start }
      subtract = var:sed_wood_goal_price_start } } }
   }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_sample_month value = sed_live_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_iron value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {

   market = { mg:iron ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_iron_mine } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_iron value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_iron value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:iron ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_iron_short_sample_month } }
   remove_variable = sed_iron_short_months
   remove_variable = sed_iron_meta_year
  }
  if = { limit = {  market = { mg:iron ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_iron_short_sample_month var:sed_iron_short_sample_month = sed_live_month_key } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_short_sample_gap value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_iron_short_sample_month }
     set_variable = { name = sed_short_sample_gap value = { value = sed_live_month_key subtract = var:sed_iron_short_sample_month } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:sed_short_sample_gap = 1 has_variable = sed_iron_short_months }
     change_variable = { name = sed_iron_short_months add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_iron_short_months value = 1 } }
    remove_variable = sed_short_sample_gap
   }
   else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_iron_short_months } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_iron_short_months value = 1 }
   }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_iron_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_iron_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_iron_meta_year value = year }
     set_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_streak value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_iron_meta_since value = year }
     # Price at the moment the goal begins, so its outcome can be measured later.
     set_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_price_start value = {
      value = 0 market ?= { mg:iron ?= { value = market_goods_pricier multiply = 100 } } } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:sed_iron_meta_year < year }
     # Consecutive annual goals form a multi-year goal; a skipped year restarts it.
     if = { limit = { var:sed_iron_meta_year = var:sed_prev_year }
      change_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_streak add = 1 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_streak value = { value = var:sed_iron_goal_streak max = 5 } }
     }
     else = {
      set_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_streak value = 1 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_iron_meta_since value = year }
     }
     set_variable = { name = sed_iron_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = {
   remove_variable = sed_iron_short_months
   # Shortage gone while a goal was active: record how long it lasted and how far
   # the market price moved from the goal's own starting point. This is a reading
   # for the player, not an economic effect; a new goal overwrites it.
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_iron_meta_year }
    set_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_result_year value = year }
    set_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_result_years value = {
     value = year subtract = var:sed_iron_meta_since min = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_iron_goal_result_price value = {

  every_scope_state = {

  }
 }

sed_refresh_direct_budget = {
 sed_refresh_public_upkeep = yes
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_known value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_points value = {
   value = modifier:country_construction_add min = 0
   max = { value = modifier:country_max_weekly_construction_progress_add min = 0 }
  } }

  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_wooden_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 1750.000000 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_iron_frame_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 1260.000000 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_steel_frame_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 945.000000 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_arc_welded_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 921.666667 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_wooden_buildings has_active_production_method = pm_iron_frame_buildings has_active_production_method = pm_steel_frame_buildings has_active_production_method = pm_arc_welded_buildings } } }
  } } set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_known value = 0 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_material_capacity value = {
   value = 0
   every_scope_state = {
    limit = { has_building = building_construction_sector
     b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 }
    }

    if = { limit = { b:building_construction_sector = { has_active_production_method = pm_wooden_buildings } }
     add = { value = b:building_construction_sector.level
      multiply = { value = b:building_construction_sector.occupancy min = 0 max = 1 }
      multiply = 3500
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_construction_sector = { has_active_production_method = pm_iron_frame_buildings } }
     add = { value = b:building_construction_sector.level
      multiply = { value = b:building_construction_sector.occupancy min = 0 max = 1 }
      multiply = 6300
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_construction_sector = { has_active_production_method = pm_steel_frame_buildings } }
     add = { value = b:building_construction_sector.level
      multiply = { value = b:building_construction_sector.occupancy min = 0 max = 1 }
      multiply = 9450
     }
    }

      has_variable = sed_tools_request_pending var:sed_tools_intent_level = 0
var:sed_tools_intent_variant = 1
     } add = 600 }
     if = { limit = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_food_industry }
      has_variable = sed_groceries_request_pending var:sed_groceries_intent_level = 0
var:sed_groceries_intent_variant = 1
     } add = 600 }
     if = { limit = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_textile_mill }
      has_variable = sed_clothes_request_pending var:sed_clothes_intent_level = 0
var:sed_clothes_intent_variant = 1
     } add = 600 }
     if = { limit = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_arms_industry }
      has_variable = sed_small_arms_request_pending var:sed_small_arms_intent_level = 0
var:sed_small_arms_intent_variant = 1
     } add = 600 }
     if = { limit = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_artillery_foundry }
      has_variable = sed_artillery_request_pending var:sed_artillery_intent_level = 0
var:sed_artillery_intent_variant = 1
     } add = 600 }
     if = { limit = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_munition_plant }
      has_variable = sed_ammunition_request_pending var:sed_ammunition_intent_level = 0
var:sed_ammunition_intent_variant = 1
     } add = 800 }
     if = { limit = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_paper_mill }
      has_variable = sed_paper_request_pending var:sed_paper_intent_level = 0
var:sed_paper_intent_variant = 1
     } add = 600 }
     if = { limit = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_railway }
      has_variable = sed_railway_request_pending var:sed_railway_intent_level = 0

     } add = 800 }
    }
   } }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_levels_unknown value = {
   value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels
   subtract = var:sed_build_budget_queue_levels_known min = 0
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_points value = {
   value = var:sed_build_budget_queue_points
   add = { value = var:sed_build_budget_queue_levels_unknown multiply = 6000 }
   max = { value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels min = 0 multiply = 6000 }
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { modifier:country_construction_add > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks value = {
    value = var:sed_build_budget_queue_points divide = modifier:country_construction_add
   } }
  }
  # Engine project counts: levels answer "how much", projects answer "how many works".
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_projects value = {
   value = num_queued_government_constructions min = 0 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_private_projects value = {
   value = num_queued_private_constructions min = 0 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration > 0 }
   if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 2 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 2 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 4 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 4 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 6 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 6 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 8 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 8 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 12 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 12 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 16 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 16 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 20 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 20 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 26 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 26 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 32 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 32 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 40 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 40 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 52 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 52 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 78 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 78 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 104 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 104 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 156 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 156 } }
   else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_government_duration <= 208 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 208 } }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_queue_weeks_engine value = 260 } }
  }

  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_project_weeks value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_project_materials value = {
   value = var:sed_build_budget_project_points multiply = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost
  } }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_build_budget_project_points > 0 var:sed_build_budget_points > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_project_weeks value = {
    value = var:sed_build_budget_project_points divide = var:sed_build_budget_points
   } }
  }
  # The window is the work itself plus one month of slack. A fixed six-month
  # floor used to override cheap projects and block them for a horizon they
  # never occupy; a long queue still extends the window through its own weeks.
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_funding_weeks value = {
   value = var:sed_build_budget_project_weeks add = var:sed_build_budget_queue_weeks add = 4
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_required_gold value = {
   value = sed_fixed_expenses_value min = 0 multiply = 4
   if = { limit = { principal <= 0 net_fixed_income >= 0 net_total_income > 0
    net_total_income >= var:sed_build_budget_weekly }
    value = { value = sed_fixed_expenses_value min = 0 multiply = 2 }
   }
   add = { value = var:sed_build_budget_weekly subtract = net_total_income min = 0
    multiply = var:sed_build_budget_funding_weeks
   }
  } }
  # Distance between the treasury and the required reserve, so the player reads
  # how much gold is missing instead of comparing two numbers.
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_gold_gap value = sed_live_build_budget_gold_gap }
 }
}
# Country scope; read-only military-economic assessment.
sed_refresh_military_plan = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_expenses value = military_expenses }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_share value = military_expenses_share }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_at_war value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_military_at_war value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 0 }

  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_small_arms value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:small_arms ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_small_arms value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_artillery value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:artillery ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_artillery value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ammunition value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:ammunition ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ammunition value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_manowars value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:manowars ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_manowars value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ironclads value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:ironclads ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ironclads value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  if = { limit = { military_expenses > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 1 }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_military_shortage_count > 0 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 2 }
   }
   if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 net_fixed_income < 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 3 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_military_shortage_count = 0
    sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes principal <= 0 net_total_income > 0
    gold_reserves >= { value = sed_fixed_expenses_value min = 0 multiply = 12 }
   } set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 4 } }
  }
 }
}
# Country scope. TAX_LEVELS is ordered: very_low, low, medium, high, very_high.
# Snapshot before the first change so leaving Automatic or disabling can restore.
sed_tax_policy_save = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes NOT = { has_variable = sed_tax_level_saved } }
  if = { limit = { tax_level = very_low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 1 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 2 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = medium }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 4 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = very_high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 5 }
  }
 }
}

sed_apply_fiscal_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
   has_variable = sed_fiscal_status
   NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual }
   NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted }
   NOT = { sed_tax_month_limit_reached = yes }
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 2 var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 } }
   if = { limit = { tax_level = very_low } sed_tax_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 1 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = low } sed_tax_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = medium } sed_tax_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = high }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high } sed_tax_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = very_high }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 1 var:sed_fiscal_status = 5 }
    gold_reserves >= { value = sed_fixed_expenses_value min = 0 multiply = 12 }
    principal <= 0
    net_total_income > 0
   }
   if = { limit = { tax_level = medium } sed_tax_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high } sed_tax_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = very_high } sed_tax_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = high }
  }
 }
}

sed_restore_fiscal_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_tax_level_saved }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 1 } set_tax_level = very_low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 2 } set_tax_level = low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 3 } set_tax_level = medium }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 4 } set_tax_level = high }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 5 } set_tax_level = very_high }
  remove_variable = sed_tax_level_saved
 }
}

   else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = low } sed_wage_policy_save = yes set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_from value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_government_wage_level = medium }
  }
 }

sed_apply_military_wage_policy = {
 if = { limit = {
  is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
  has_variable = sed_fiscal_status
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual }
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted }
  NOT = { sed_military_wage_month_limit_reached = yes }
 }
  if = { limit = {
   OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 }
   net_fixed_income < 0 military_expenses > 0
   NOT = { sed_military_readiness_required = yes }
  }
   if = { limit = { military_wage_level = medium } sed_save_military_wage = yes set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_from value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_military_wage_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { military_wage_level = high } sed_save_military_wage = yes set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_from value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_military_wage_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { military_wage_level = very_high } sed_save_military_wage = yes set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_from value = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_to value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_military_wage_level = high }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_military_wage_saved }
   if = { limit = {
    military_wage_level = very_low
    var:sed_military_wage_saved > 1
    OR = { sed_military_wage_recovery_affordable = yes sed_military_readiness_required = yes }
   } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_from value = 1 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_military_wage_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = {
    military_wage_level = low
    var:sed_military_wage_saved > 2
    OR = { sed_military_wage_recovery_affordable = yes sed_military_readiness_required = yes }
   } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_from value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_military_wage_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = {
    military_wage_level = medium
    var:sed_military_wage_saved > 3
    OR = { sed_military_wage_recovery_affordable = yes  }
   } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_from value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_to value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_military_wage_level = high }
   else_if = { limit = {
    military_wage_level = high
    var:sed_military_wage_saved > 4
    OR = { sed_military_wage_recovery_affordable = yes  }
   } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_from value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_to value = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_military_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_military_wage_level = very_high }
  }
 }
}

sed_restore_military_wage_policy = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_military_wage_saved }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_military_wage_saved = 1 } set_military_wage_level = very_low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_military_wage_saved = 2 } set_military_wage_level = low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_military_wage_saved = 3 } set_military_wage_level = medium }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_military_wage_saved = 4 } set_military_wage_level = high }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_military_wage_saved = 5 } set_military_wage_level = very_high }
  remove_variable = sed_military_wage_saved
 }
}

sed_modernize_existing_industry = {
 if = { limit = {
  is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual }
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted }
  NOT = { sed_pm_upgrade_month_limit_reached = yes }
  NOT = { sed_auto_month_limit_reached = yes }
  NOT = { in_default = yes }
  NOT = { has_variable = aroai_autobuild }
  NOT = { has_variable = advisor_pm_balance_enabled }
  NOT = { has_variable = advisor_labor_auto_enabled }
  NOT = { sed_ogas_pm_active = yes }
  OR = { has_variable = sed_coord_active NOT = { sed_competing_builder_configured = yes } }
 }
  sed_begin_pm_input_reservations = yes
  every_scope_state = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_pm_upgrade_score value = 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_pm_upgrade_choice value = 0 }

   if = { limit = { sed_pm_upgrade_1_eligible = yes var:sed_pm_upgrade_score < { value = 200 multiply = b:building_logging_camp.level multiply = b:building_logging_camp.occupancy
     if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_investment_wage_known var:sed_investment_wage_known = 1 }
      subtract = { value = 250 multiply = b:building_logging_camp.level multiply = b:building_logging_camp.occupancy multiply = var:sed_investment_wage_unit } } } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_pm_upgrade_score value = { value = 200 multiply = b:building_logging_camp.level multiply = b:building_logging_camp.occupancy
     if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_investment_wage_known var:sed_investment_wage_known = 1 }
      subtract = { value = 250 multiply = b:building_logging_camp.level multiply = b:building_logging_camp.occupancy multiply = var:sed_investment_wage_unit } } } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_pm_upgrade_choice value = 1 }
   }
   if = { limit = { sed_pm_upgrade_2_eligible = yes var:sed_pm_upgrade_score < { value = 362.5 multiply = b:building_logging_camp.level multiply = b:building_logging_camp.occupancy
     if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_investment_wage_known var:sed_investment_wage_known = 1 }

sed_coord_capture_supply_policy = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_coord_active
  has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated value = var:zw_var_develop_incorporated_states }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_ip_incorporated }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated value = var:zw_var_ip_incorporated }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved value = yes }
 }
}

sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = {

  has_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol value = var:advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }

  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury value = var:advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off value = var:advisor_setting_treasury_off }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_borrow }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_borrow value = var:advisor_setting_borrow }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_labor_auto_enabled }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_labor_auto value = var:advisor_labor_auto_enabled }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_policy_saved value = yes }
 }
}

sed_coord_enable = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_advisor value = var:advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_expand_building }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_chains value = var:zw_var_expand_building }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_sectors value = var:zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_railways value = var:zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_power value = var:zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_admin value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_tax value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
  }
  if = { limit = { OR = {
   has_variable = advisor_enabled
   has_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled
  } } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_known value = yes } }
  if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = zw_var_expand_building var:zw_var_expand_building > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors var:zw_var_more_construction_sectors > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway var:zw_var_scsab_construct_railway > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant var:zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_added_constructions var:zw_var_added_constructions > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_labor_threshold var:zw_var_labor_threshold > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors_gold_reserves var:zw_var_more_construction_sectors_gold_reserves > 0 } AND = { has_variable = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states var:zw_var_develop_incorporated_states > 0 } } } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_supply_known value = yes } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_active value = yes }
  sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = yes
  remove_variable = sed_mode_manual
  remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted
  set_variable = { name = sed_mode_automatic value = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
  sed_schedule_auto_event = yes
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
  sed_coord_sync = yes
 }
}

sed_coord_restore = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor }
   set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_advisor }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = var:sed_coord_saved_chains }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_expand_building }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_sectors }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_more_construction_sectors value = var:sed_coord_saved_sectors }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_railways }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway value = var:sed_coord_saved_railways }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_power }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant value = var:sed_coord_saved_power }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_admin }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin value = var:sed_coord_saved_admin }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_tax }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax value = var:sed_coord_saved_tax }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol value = var:sed_coord_saved_goal_sol }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury value = var:sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_treasury_off value = var:sed_coord_saved_treasury_off }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_borrow }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_borrow value = var:sed_coord_saved_borrow }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_borrow }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_labor_auto }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_labor_auto_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_labor_auto }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_labor_auto_enabled }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states value = var:sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_ip_incorporated value = var:sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = zw_var_ip_incorporated }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution value = var:sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution }
  }
  remove_variable = sed_coord_active
  remove_variable = sed_coord_supply_known
  remove_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known
  remove_variable = sed_coord_executor
  remove_variable = sed_coord_advisor_policy
  remove_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved
  remove_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_sectors
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_railways
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_power
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_admin
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_tax
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_borrow
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_labor_auto
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions
 }
