sed_coord_sync = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual } NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted } has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  sed_coord_capture_supply_policy = yes
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known }
   sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = yes
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_outcome_workers var:sed_outcome_workers > 0 }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_labor_auto_enabled value = yes }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_labor_auto }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_labor_auto_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_labor_auto }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_labor_auto_enabled }
  }

  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states value = yes }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_ip_incorporated value = yes }
   remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution
  }
  remove_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled
  remove_variable = zw_var_expand_building
  remove_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = aroai_autobuild } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 5 } }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_ogas_construction_active = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 14 } }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_pm_upgrade_month_limit_reached = yes }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 13 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { OR = { sed_coord_fiscal_safe = yes AND = { sed_watch_recovery_candidate = yes sed_direct_fiscal_safe = yes } } NOT = { in_default = yes } is_construction_paused = no }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 2 sed_direct_fiscal_safe = yes sed_direct_supply_priority_exists = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 11 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { sed_watch_recovery_candidate = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 11 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_waiting = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 10 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 1 has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 2 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 6 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 6 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 7 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 7 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 9 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 8 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_more_construction_sectors value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 4 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { sed_civic_direct_available = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 11 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 6 var:sed_plan_goal = 7 var:sed_plan_goal = 9 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 9 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { sed_university_ready = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 11 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { sed_outcome_growth_wait = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 0 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 1 var:sed_plan_goal = 2 var:sed_plan_goal = 3 var:sed_plan_goal = 5 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor }
 set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_advisor }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 1 }
    sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = yes
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_borrow
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { principal > 0 credit > 0 principal >= { value = credit multiply = 0.5 } }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_treasury_off value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = {
     sed_coord_advisor_sol_pressure = yes
     AND = { has_variable = sed_asc_rank_delta var:sed_asc_rank_delta >= 0 has_variable = sed_asc_sol_delta var:sed_asc_sol_delta <= 0 }
     any_scope_state = { OR = { var:sed_plan_grain_rank = 1 var:sed_plan_groceries_rank = 1 var:sed_plan_clothes_rank = 1 } }
     AND = { var:sed_plan_goal = 5 OR = { var:sed_plan_missing_grain = 1 var:sed_plan_missing_groceries = 1 var:sed_plan_missing_clothes = 1 } }
    } }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 2 }
    }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 2 var:sed_plan_goal = 5 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = var:sed_coord_saved_chains }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 3 }
   }
  }
 }
}
# State scope. Queue one public level and record the intent for the monthly
# review, mirroring the railway executor: only a queue count increase confirms it.
sed_run_trade_center_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_trade_center_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  if = { limit = { has_building = building_trade_center }
   set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_intent_level value = b:building_trade_center.level }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_intent_level value = 0 } }
  start_building_construction = building_trade_center
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_trade_center_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = { remove_variable = sed_trade_center_intent_level }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

}

# Completion is inferred from the queue leaving and the level rising.
sed_refresh_trade_center = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_candidate_states value = 0 }
  every_scope_state = {
   if = { limit = { sed_trade_center_candidate_eligible = yes }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_candidate_states add = 1 } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_trade_center_request_pending
     OR = {
      NOT = { has_building = building_trade_center }
      b:building_trade_center = { level_after_queued_constructions <= level }
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_trade_center_intent_level
     has_building = building_trade_center b:building_trade_center.level > var:sed_trade_center_intent_level }
     owner = {
      if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_trade_center_completed }
       change_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_completed add = 1 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_completed value = 1 } }
      set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_result value = 1 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
     }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_trade_center_intent_level }
     owner = {
      if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_trade_center_abandoned }
       change_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_abandoned add = 1 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_abandoned value = 1 } }
      set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_result value = 2 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_trade_center_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
     }
    }
    remove_variable = sed_trade_center_intent_level
    remove_variable = sed_trade_center_request_pending
   }
  }
 }
}

     set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 22 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year }
    }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = { remove_variable = sed_construction_intent_level }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

sed_run_core_wood_approval = {

 if = {
  limit = { sed_core_wood_approval_valid = yes }

   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_level value = b:building_logging_camp.level }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_variant value = 1 }
  start_building_construction = building_logging_camp
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic }
     set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 19 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

# State scope. Queue one public level under the growth lane. Reuses the ledger
# variables of the good, so the monthly reconciliation already covers it.
sed_run_core_iron_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_core_iron_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_iron_intent_level value = b:building_iron_mine.level }
  set_variable = { name = sed_iron_intent_variant value = 1 }
  start_building_construction = building_iron_mine
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_iron_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic }
     set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_state value = prev }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_action value = 20 }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_last_build_year value = year }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_iron_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_iron_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_iron_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_iron_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_iron_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_iron_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_iron_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }

}# All entry points use the player country as root.
sed_asc_refresh = {
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_rank value = 1 }
 remove_variable = sed_asc_next
 remove_variable = sed_asc_gap
 every_country = {
  limit = { sed_asc_ahead = yes }
  root = { change_variable = { name = sed_asc_rank add = 1 } }
 }
 ordered_country = {
  limit = { sed_asc_ahead = yes }
  order_by = { value = prestige multiply = -1 }
  max = 1
  check_range_bounds = no
  root = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_asc_next value = prev }
   set_variable = { name = sed_asc_gap value = { value = prev.prestige subtract = prestige } }
  }
 }
 sed_asc_diplomacy = yes
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_rank_now value = var:sed_asc_rank }
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_prestige_now value = prestige }
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_balance_now value = net_total_income }
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_sol_now value = average_sol }
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_army_now value = army_power_projection }
 set_variable = { name = sed_asc_navy_now value = navy_size }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_asc_window_start } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_window_start value = sed_live_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_rank_base value = var:sed_asc_rank_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_prestige_base value = var:sed_asc_prestige_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_balance_base value = var:sed_asc_balance_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_sol_base value = var:sed_asc_sol_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_army_base value = var:sed_asc_army_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_navy_base value = var:sed_asc_navy_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_construction_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_tax_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_wage_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_military_wage_count value = 0 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = {
  sed_live_month_key >= { value = var:sed_asc_window_start add = 12 }
 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_rank_delta value = {
   value = var:sed_asc_rank_now subtract = var:sed_asc_rank_base
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_prestige_delta value = {
   value = var:sed_asc_prestige_now subtract = var:sed_asc_prestige_base
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_balance_delta value = {
   value = var:sed_asc_balance_now subtract = var:sed_asc_balance_base
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_sol_delta value = {
   value = var:sed_asc_sol_now subtract = var:sed_asc_sol_base
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_army_delta value = {
   value = var:sed_asc_army_now subtract = var:sed_asc_army_base
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_navy_delta value = {
   value = var:sed_asc_navy_now subtract = var:sed_asc_navy_base
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_rank_base value = var:sed_asc_rank_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_prestige_base value = var:sed_asc_prestige_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_balance_base value = var:sed_asc_balance_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_sol_base value = var:sed_asc_sol_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_army_base value = var:sed_asc_army_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_navy_base value = var:sed_asc_navy_now }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_construction_annual value = var:sed_asc_construction_count }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_construction_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_tax_annual value = var:sed_asc_tax_count }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_tax_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_wage_annual value = var:sed_asc_wage_count }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_wage_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_military_wage_annual value = var:sed_asc_military_wage_count }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_military_wage_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_window_start value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 if = { limit = { in_default = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 1 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes is_diplomatic_play_initiator = yes is_diplomatic_play_target = yes } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 2 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { OR = { net_total_income < 0 NOT = { sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes } } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 3 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_plan_goal OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 2 var:sed_plan_goal = 5 var:sed_plan_goal = 6 var:sed_plan_goal = 7 var:sed_plan_goal = 9 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 4 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_technology_researched = railways } any_scope_state = { is_incorporated = yes infrastructure_delta < 0 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 5 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { var:sed_asc_protection = 2 has_variable = sed_asc_partner }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 6 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_asc_rank_delta var:sed_asc_rank_delta >= 0 var:sed_asc_army_delta <= 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 7 }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_plan_goal var:sed_plan_goal = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 8 }
 }
 else = {
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_priority value = 9 }
 }
}

sed_asc_diplomacy = {

 remove_variable = sed_asc_liberty
 remove_variable = sed_asc_partner

  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_protection value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_overlord value = overlord }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_liberty value = liberty_desire }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { any_scope_treaty = { any_scope_article = {
  OR = { has_type = alliance has_type = defensive_pact }
 } } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_asc_protection value = 3 }
 }
 else = {
  ordered_country = {
   limit = { sed_asc_partner_candidate = yes }
   order_by = { value = relations:root add = { value = army_power_projection divide = 100 } }
   max = 1
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { set_variable = { name = sed_asc_partner value = prev } }
  }
 }

   change_variable = { name = sed_asc_wage_count add = 1 }

  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_military_wage_last_change_month var:sed_military_wage_last_change_month = sed_live_month_key }
   change_variable = { name = sed_asc_military_wage_count add = 1 }
  }
 }

sed_watch_review = {
 if = { limit = {
  is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted }
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual }
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_watch_month var:sed_watch_month = sed_live_month_key }
 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_watch_month value = sed_live_month_key }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_watch_idle } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_watch_idle value = 0 }
  }
  if = { limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_watch_idle value = 0 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_watch_delegated
   has_variable = sed_coord_executor var:sed_coord_executor = 1
   construction_queue_num_queued_private_levels = 0 is_construction_paused = no
  }
   change_variable = { name = sed_watch_idle add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_watch_idle value = 0 } }
  remove_variable = sed_watch_delegated
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active has_variable = sed_coord_executor
   var:sed_coord_executor = 1 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_watch_delegated value = yes }
  }
 }
 sed_watch_diagnose = yes
}
sed_watch_diagnose = {
 set_variable = { name = sed_watch_status value = 0 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_watch_idle var:sed_watch_idle >= 2
  has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted }
 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_watch_status value = 1 }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_direct_fiscal_safe = yes } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_watch_status value = 2 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_private_levels > 0 is_construction_paused = no }
   set_variable = { name = sed_watch_status value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { is_construction_paused = yes }
   set_variable = { name = sed_watch_status value = 4 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_watch_recovery_candidate = yes }
   set_variable = { name = sed_watch_status value = 5 }
  }
 }
}
sed_follow_projects = {
 set_variable = { name = sed_follow_staff value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_follow_inputs value = 0 }
 every_scope_state = {
  if = { limit = {
   has_variable = sed_wood_intent_level has_building = building_logging_camp
   b:building_logging_camp.level > var:sed_wood_intent_level
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_follow_wood value = yes }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_follow_wood }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_logging_camp } }
    remove_variable = sed_follow_wood
   }
   else_if = { limit = { b:building_logging_camp = {
    occupancy >= 0.8 has_failed_hires = no building_has_goods_shortage = no
   } }
    remove_variable = sed_follow_wood
   }
   else = {
    if = { limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes } } }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_follow_staff add = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_follow_inputs add = 1 } }
    }
   }
  }
  if = { limit = {
   has_variable = sed_iron_intent_level has_building = building_iron_mine
   b:building_iron_mine.level > var:sed_iron_intent_level
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_follow_iron value = yes }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_follow_iron }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_iron_mine } }
    remove_variable = sed_follow_iron
   }
   else_if = { limit = { b:building_iron_mine = {
    occupancy >= 0.8 has_failed_hires = no building_has_goods_shortage = no
   } }
    remove_variable = sed_follow_iron
   }
   else = {
    if = { limit = { b:building_iron_mine = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes } } }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_follow_staff add = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_iron_mine = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_follow_inputs add = 1 } }
    }
   }
  }
  if = { limit = {
   has_variable = sed_tools_intent_level has_building = building_tooling_workshop
   b:building_tooling_workshop.level > var:sed_tools_intent_level
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_follow_tools value = yes }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_follow_tools }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_tooling_workshop } }
    remove_variable = sed_follow_tools
   }
   else_if = { limit = { b:building_tooling_workshop = {
    occupancy >= 0.8 has_failed_hires = no building_has_goods_shortage = no
   } }
    remove_variable = sed_follow_tools
   }
   else = {
    if = { limit = { b:building_tooling_workshop = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes } } }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_follow_staff add = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_tooling_workshop = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_follow_inputs add = 1 } }
    }
   }
  }
 }
}
sed_outcome_review = {
 if = { limit = {
  NOT = { has_variable = sed_outcome_month var:sed_outcome_month = sed_live_month_key }
 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_month value = sed_live_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_staff value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_inputs value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_market value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_observed value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_workers value = 0 }
  remove_variable = sed_problem_state
  remove_variable = sed_problem_type
  remove_variable = sed_problem_good
  set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_hiring value = 0 }
  every_scope_state = {
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_angkor_wat }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_level b:building_angkor_wat.level > var:sed_outcome_angkor_wat_level }
     set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_pending value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_since value = sed_live_month_key }
    }
    set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_level value = b:building_angkor_wat.level }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_pending }
     if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_since } }
      set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_since value = sed_live_month_key }
     }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_observed add = 1 } }
     if = { limit = { b:building_angkor_wat = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes } } }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_hiring add = 1 } }
      if = { limit = { sed_live_month_key >= { value = var:sed_outcome_angkor_wat_since add = 3 } }
       root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_staff add = 1 } }
       if = { limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 1000 }
        root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_workers add = 1 } }
       }
      }
     }
     if = { limit = { b:building_angkor_wat = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_inputs add = 1 } }
     }
     if = { limit = {
      owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_problem_type } }
      b:building_angkor_wat = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
     }
      root = {
       set_variable = { name = sed_problem_state value = prev }
       set_variable = { name = sed_problem_type value = 1 }
      }

     }
     if = { limit = { always = no }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_market add = 1 } }
     }
     else_if = { limit = { b:building_angkor_wat = {
      occupancy >= 0.8 has_failed_hires = no building_has_goods_shortage = no
     } }
      remove_variable = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_pending
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_level value = 0 }
    remove_variable = sed_outcome_angkor_wat_pending
   }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_arms_industry }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_outcome_arms_industry_level b:building_arms_industry.level > var:sed_outcome_arms_industry_level }
     set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_arms_industry_pending value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_arms_industry_since value = sed_live_month_key }
    }
    set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_arms_industry_level value = b:building_arms_industry.level }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_outcome_arms_industry_pending }
     if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_outcome_arms_industry_since } }
      set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_arms_industry_since value = sed_live_month_key }
     }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_observed add = 1 } }
     if = { limit = { b:building_arms_industry = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes } } }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_hiring add = 1 } }
      if = { limit = { sed_live_month_key >= { value = var:sed_outcome_arms_industry_since add = 3 } }
       root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_staff add = 1 } }
       if = { limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 1000 }
        root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_workers add = 1 } }
       }
      }
     }
     if = { limit = { b:building_arms_industry = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_inputs add = 1 } }
     }
     if = { limit = {
      owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_problem_type } }
      b:building_arms_industry = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
     }
      root = {
       set_variable = { name = sed_problem_state value = prev }
       set_variable = { name = sed_problem_type value = 2 }
      }
     if = { limit = {
      owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_problem_good } market = { mg:coal ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
      b:building_arms_industry = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_rotary_valve_engine_building_arms_industry } }
     }
      root = { set_variable = { name = sed_problem_good value = 4 } }
     }
     if = { limit = {
      owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_problem_good } market = { mg:copper ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
      b:building_arms_industry = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_assembly_lines_building_arms_industry } }
     }
      root = { set_variable = { name = sed_problem_good value = 5 } }
     }
     if = { limit = {
      owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_problem_good } market = { mg:hardwood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
      b:building_arms_industry = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_bolt_action_rifles has_active_production_method = pm_muskets has_active_production_method = pm_repeaters has_active_production_method = pm_rifles } }
     }
      root = { set_variable = { name = sed_problem_good value = 14 } }
     }
     if = { limit = {
      owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_problem_good } market = { mg:iron ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
      b:building_arms_industry = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_muskets } }
     }
      root = { set_variable = { name = sed_problem_good value = 15 } }
     }

     if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { b:building_wheat_farm = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_citrus_orchards } } owner = { market = { mg:fruit ?= { market_goods_sell_orders > market_goods_buy_orders market_goods_cheaper = yes } } } } AND = { b:building_wheat_farm = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer has_active_production_method = pm_fertilization has_active_production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming has_active_production_method = pm_simple_farming has_active_production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } } owner = { market = { mg:grain ?= { market_goods_sell_orders > market_goods_buy_orders market_goods_cheaper = yes } } } } AND = { b:building_wheat_farm = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_citrus_orchards has_active_production_method = pm_sugar_beets } } owner = { market = { mg:sugar ?= { market_goods_sell_orders > market_goods_buy_orders market_goods_cheaper = yes } } } } } }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_market add = 1 } }
     }
     else_if = { limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = {
      occupancy >= 0.8 has_failed_hires = no building_has_goods_shortage = no
     } }
      remove_variable = sed_outcome_wheat_farm_pending
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_wheat_farm_level value = 0 }
    remove_variable = sed_outcome_wheat_farm_pending
   }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_white_house }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_outcome_white_house_level b:building_white_house.level > var:sed_outcome_white_house_level }
     set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_white_house_pending value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_white_house_since value = sed_live_month_key }
    }
    set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_white_house_level value = b:building_white_house.level }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_outcome_white_house_pending }
     if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_outcome_white_house_since } }
      set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_white_house_since value = sed_live_month_key }
     }
     root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_observed add = 1 } }
     if = { limit = { b:building_white_house = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes } } }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_hiring add = 1 } }
      if = { limit = { sed_live_month_key >= { value = var:sed_outcome_white_house_since add = 3 } }
       root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_staff add = 1 } }
       if = { limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 1000 }
        root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_workers add = 1 } }
       }
      }
     }
     if = { limit = { b:building_white_house = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_inputs add = 1 } }
     }
     if = { limit = {
      owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_problem_type } }
      b:building_white_house = { OR = { occupancy < 0.8 has_failed_hires = yes building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
     }
      root = {
       set_variable = { name = sed_problem_state value = prev }
       set_variable = { name = sed_problem_type value = 84 }
      }

     }
     if = { limit = { always = no }
      root = { change_variable = { name = sed_outcome_market add = 1 } }
     }
     else_if = { limit = { b:building_white_house = {
      occupancy >= 0.8 has_failed_hires = no building_has_goods_shortage = no
     } }
      remove_variable = sed_outcome_white_house_pending
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_outcome_white_house_level value = 0 }
    remove_variable = sed_outcome_white_house_pending
   }
  }
 }
}
sed_refresh_public_upkeep = {
 set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_university_known value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_university_cost value = 787.5 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_investment_wage_known var:sed_investment_wage_known = 1 }
  change_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_university_cost add = {
   value = var:sed_investment_wage_unit multiply = 2900.0 multiply = 1.25
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_university_known value = 1 }
 }
 every_scope_state = {
  limit = { has_building = building_university b:building_university = { level > 0 occupancy >= 0.5 earnings >= weekly_profit } }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_university_cost value = {
    value = var:sed_upkeep_university_cost
    min = { value = prev.b:building_university.earnings subtract = prev.b:building_university.weekly_profit
     divide = prev.b:building_university.level divide = prev.b:building_university.occupancy
     multiply = 1.25 add = 787.5 }
   } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_university_known value = 1 }
  }
 }

 set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_admin_known value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_admin_cost value = 1662.5 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_investment_wage_known var:sed_investment_wage_known = 1 }
  change_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_admin_cost add = {
   value = var:sed_investment_wage_unit multiply = 5000.0 multiply = 1.25
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_admin_known value = 1 }
 }
 every_scope_state = {
  limit = { has_building = building_government_administration b:building_government_administration = { level > 0 occupancy >= 0.5 earnings >= weekly_profit } }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_admin_cost value = {
    value = var:sed_upkeep_admin_cost
    min = { value = prev.b:building_government_administration.earnings subtract = prev.b:building_government_administration.weekly_profit
     divide = prev.b:building_government_administration.level divide = prev.b:building_government_administration.occupancy
     multiply = 1.25 add = 1662.5 }
   } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_upkeep_admin_known value = 1 }
  }
 }

}
# Assisted mode: explain why there are recommendations to approve.
sed_maybe_notify_assisted_recommendation = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   has_variable = sed_mode_assisted
   has_variable = sed_plan_count var:sed_plan_count > 0
   has_variable = sed_plan_goal var:sed_plan_goal > 0
   OR = {
    NOT = { has_variable = sed_assist_notice_month }
    var:sed_assist_notice_month <= sed_live_month_key
   }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_assist_notice_month value = { value = sed_live_month_key add = 1 } }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 1 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.21 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 2 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.22 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 3 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.23 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 4 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.24 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 5 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.25 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 6 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.26 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 7 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.27 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.28 days = 0 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 9 } trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.29 days = 0 } }
 }
}
# Country scope. Fires a visible event only when local supply cannot respond.
# The script has no trade-route effect in 1.15 (create_trade_route was removed in 1.9),
# so the event advises the player instead of acting.

    NOT = { has_variable = sed_import_notice_wood_month }

   }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { has_variable = sed_wood_request_pending } }
  }

   value = { value = 0 market = { mg:wood ?= { add = market_goods_buy_orders } } } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_import_notice_wood_sell
